entries.title: How to talk to a folk
q: how do i talk to villagers
how do i speak to a villager
how does the conversation screen work
how do i chat with npcs
how do i say goodbye to a folk
entries.answer: Right-click a folk to talk. Pick a tab down the side (Chat, About, Ask, Trade, Town, World) or type anything in the box.
more: At the top, Suggested picks the few things most worth saying just now.
Bye (or Esc) says goodbye.
steps: Pick a tab on the left, or press 1-9 for an option.
Use the Suggested row for what matters now (a quest step, a fine owed, its birthday).
Type anything into the box at the bottom and press Say, or Enter.
Esc or Backspace backs out of a group; Bye closes.
controls: Tabs: Chat · About · Ask · Trade · Town · World
tips: Options that don't apply to this folk just now are hidden (a farmer's own options only show to a farmer).
Talking once a day warms each folk to you.

entries.title: Saying anything (typing to a folk)
q: how do i ask a villager a custom question
what can i say to folk
entries.answer: Type anything into the talk screen's box and press Enter: the folk works out what you mean from your words.
more: Type anything into the box at the bottom of the talk screen and press Say (or Enter): 'how are you?', 'show me the café', '8 bread, please?', 'what do you think of Bryn?'.
steps: Press T or Enter on the talk screen to start typing.
tips: It's talking, not chat or a command: it works on any server.
Ask about anyone by name to hear what the folk thinks of them.

entries.title: Chat: news, gossip, jokes
q: ask a villager for a joke
entries.answer: The talk screen's Chat tab passes the time of day: how it is, the news, gossip, a joke, and a word of praise.
more: (the town's age, what it needs most, the latest), Gossip (who's sweet on whom, who can't stand whom, what's said about you), Tell a joke, Well done!, and under More chat: its work today, pastimes, fashion, eat together, dice, I'm sorry, and gestures.
tips: A grump won't tell you a joke.
Gossip includes what folk say about you: a quick read of your name in town.

entries.title: About a folk: its life, family and home
q: how do i find out about a villager
what does a folk dream of
entries.answer: The talk screen's About tab is the folk's own life: where it came from, family and friends, its dream, memories, home and work.
more: The About tab is its life: About you (where it came from, its nature, quirk, pastime, favourite food), Family & friends, Hopes (its dream and how far it's got), Memories, and groups for Home & pet (its home, its pet, a keepsake, godparent) and Work & pay (its trade, what it's good at, its money, teach a trick, apprentice me).
tips: Folk who have lived twenty days remember how the town began.

entries.title: Asking a folk about its trade and money
q: how does a villager's trade work
ask a folk how much money it has
entries.answer: Under About, then Work & pay, a folk explains its trade, what it's good at, and how it's doing for money.
more: About → Work & pay: 'Your trade?' has a folk explain how its trade works and what its hands can make; 'Your money?' tells you how it's doing for coin (wage, savings, debts); 'Good at?' names its knacks.

entries.title: Eating together and dice
q: can i eat with a villager
how do i gamble with villagers
entries.answer: Hold food and choose Eat together to share a meal, once a day each. Dice is a small game for coins.
more: Hold some food and choose Eat together: the folk eats with you and likes you the better (more for its favourite food), once a day each.
Dice is a game for three coins out of each other's purses ('dice for 10' raises it); a shy folk may not play.
controls: [Right-click] a folk → Chat → More chat → Eat together · Dice?

entries.title: Trading with a folk
q: how do i trade with villagers
can i buy from a villager
how do i buy things from folk
entries.answer: Choose Trade, then Trade? on the talk screen: the folk offers a bundle of what its work makes for coin or an emerald.
more: Trade → Trade? has a folk offer a bundle of what its work makes (a farmer bread and roots, a miner coal and stone, a woodcutter logs) for its worth in village coin or an emerald.
When the town is short of something it may ask for some of that instead.
steps: Read the offer under the town line.
Carry the coin (or emerald) and press Hand over.
tips: A friend of the town gets half as much again for the price; an honoured guest or hero double.
The Shop group holds more: For sale?, Ask the stores, Order goods, Make me, Mend this, Haggle.
warn: It never sells what the town is short of. Someone unwelcome pays double; an outcast can't buy.

entries.title: Asking a favour
q: how do i ask for a favour
can villagers give me free stuff
entries.answer: A folk that likes you will give you something of its trade once a day. Ask it: Ask, then Favours, then A favour?
more: If a folk likes you well enough, once a day it gives you something from its trade when you ask Ask → Favours → A favour?: bread, logs, coal, wool, fish, torches or arrows.
controls: [Right-click] a folk → Ask → Favours → A favour?

entries.title: Asking a folk to come with you
q: how do i make a villager follow me
how do i send a folk home
entries.answer: Ask a folk 'Come with me' (Ask tab) and it walks with you for a while; 'Go home' sends it back.
more: Ask → Come with me: the folk walks with you for a while, then heads home (and likes you the better for the walk).
controls: [Right-click] a folk → Ask → Come with me · Go home
warn: It won't go with somebody it hardly knows, when it's miserable or at bedtime; a guard won't leave its watch and a hard worker won't leave mid-shift.

entries.title: Show me the way
q: how do i find the storehouse
how do i find a building in town
entries.answer: Ask a folk 'Show me the way' (Ask tab) and pick a place: it walks you there.
more: Ask → Show me the way lists the places a folk can walk you to: the storehouse, the village board, the elder, where it works, its home, any building the town has raised, and your own house.
Pick one and it walks you there at your pace and says a word about it.
controls: [Right-click] a folk → Ask → Show me the way → pick a place
tips: You can also type 'show me the café'.

entries.title: Hiring a folk to come adventuring
q: hire a folk to fight with me
entries.answer: Ask a folk 'Hire' (Ask tab): for its day's wage and a quarter (4 coins at least) it goes adventuring with you for a day.
more: Ask → Hire: for its own day's wage and a quarter (four coins at the least), a folk that knows you leaves its work and goes with you day and night, fights what attacks you, and picks up what falls.
Ask again to pay for another day.
When it's done it hands over what it carried and goes home with a story.

entries.title: Errands: Can I help?
q: how do i help the village
what is the village short of
how do i hand over items for an errand
entries.answer: Ask a folk 'Can I help?' (Ask tab) and it says what it needs. Bring it and press Hand over for a reward.
more: Ask → Can I help? and a folk tells you what it needs: usually what the town is short of for its next age, else something of its own, or clearing monsters.
You get experience, something from the stores and the folk's gratitude; a personal favour earns a keepsake it made.
steps: Gather what it asks for (it counts from your pack).
Talk to it again and press Hand over (the screen suggests it).
controls: [Right-click] a folk → Ask → Can I help?
warn: An errand lapses after three days.

entries.title: Looking in a folk's pack
q: how do i see what a villager is carrying
can i take items from a villager
entries.answer: Press Its pack on the talk screen (or sneak and right-click the folk) to see what it carries and wears. You can look, not take.
more: Talk goes back to the conversation; Work done shows its life's record.

entries.title: The register, ledger and history
q: how do i get the village history
entries.answer: Any folk will hand you the town's register, ledger or history: look under the talk screen's Town tab.
more: Ask any folk under Town: Residents hands you the register (every resident, trade, nature, family, mood), and Records → Town ledger (treasury, stores, who lives where, what's going up) or History (the chronicle: every building, age, birth, wedding and death, and what players did).
Records → The board reads the village board from where you stand.
controls: Town → Records → Town ledger · History · The board

entries.title: News of the world: neighbours, scouts, letters
q: what do villagers know about other towns
carry a letter for a folk
entries.answer: The talk screen's World tab is news from outside: the neighbouring towns, the scouts, letters to carry, caves, the Nether and maps.
more: The World tab: Neighbours (the towns round about and how this one stands with them), Carry a letter (the courier's post: carry a letter to another town), Out there (what the scouts have found), and groups for Underground, The Nether and Maps.

entries.title: Maps: the town map, explorer maps
q: how do i get a map of the town
entries.answer: Citizens and honoured guests can ask for a town map once a day (World, then Maps). A cartographer sells explorer and treasure maps.
more: A citizen or honoured guest can ask the storekeeper or elder for a Town map (World → Maps), one a day: a real map centred on the heart.
A cartographer sells ocean and woodland explorer maps, treasure maps, copies of the town's map, and takes commissions ('Map me the land to the east').
controls: [Right-click] a folk → World → Maps → Town map
Cartographer → World → Maps → Ocean map · Woodland map · Treasure map

entries.title: Lost and found
q: i lost my items in town
where did my dropped items go
i died in the village where are my things
has anything of mine turned up
entries.answer: Things you leave lying in a town's streets go into its Lost and Found chest by the storehouse, kept for you for three days.
more: Right-click the chest, or ask the storekeeper 'Lost & found' (Ask → Favours).
warn: What nobody comes for after three days goes into the stores.

entries.title: Teaching a folk a trick of its trade
q: how do i level up a villager
make my villager better at its job
entries.answer: Hold a tool of a folk's trade and choose Teach a trick (About, then Work & pay): once a day it learns, and may level up.
controls: [Right-click] a folk → About → Work & pay → Teach a trick
